text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho isn't far off. And although I expected Admire Vega to be locked in and ready, she seems to have lost her drive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm reminded of the fighting spirit Narita Top Road displayed the other day. Could Admire Vega be feeling anxious?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan encourages Admire Vega to eat well. She'll need to be healthy to go and win against the rivals she has to beat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega furrows her brow. Rivals she has to beat? Aren't they just obstacles she must overcome to fulfill her duty? Something feels wrong about Curren Chan's words…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, the answer eludes Admire Vega, and the day of the Satsuki Sho arrives. Here, she will compete against T.M. Opera O and Narita Top Road for glory.
